value_variant_implication.basis: The source prints R106=910 ohms and C29=56 without an explicit unit; the native-sheet capacitor convention establishes nominal 56 pF (ref/schematics/native-capacitor-value-registration.json). The owner R106-position body is marked 510R, while owner C29 population is unproved. Using the source nominal C29 only for comparison, the R106-C29 products are 50.96 ns (source resistor value) and 28.56 ns (owner-marked resistor value).
value_variant_implication.assessment: The 510R marking is a material clock-shaping value variant, not a harmless body-color difference. These simple products do not predict the actual D35.13 edge because R35, driver impedance, input thresholds, and unconfirmed C29 population also matter. Keep the source and photographed-owner variants separate until the installed resistor and capacitor are measured.

decision: The photographed owner board carried a 510R-marked body in the R106 assembly position and no separately visible C29 body in both May and July 2026. The .009 electrical drawing specifies 910 ohms for R106 and shows C29. July two-face photos support the common R35-lower/R106-upper/C29-upper node and a C29-middle route to the D56.8-grounded wide rail; these local physical paths are retained in c29-landing-pair-review.json. The installed R106 resistance, exact C29 population/value, PHI2TTL input, and D35.13 continuation remain unresolved.
